exam_metadata.subject_name: Creativity Mindset for innovation and imagination

questions.question_text: Design the stakeholder map of the poor voter turnout problem. Identify the pains and gains of each stakeholder.
Do a root cause analysis using a Mind Map to understand why India does poorly in the Olympics.
Use Lateral Thinking or the SCAMPER technique to solve the problem of people not wearing helmets while riding two-wheelers.
Use Analogous Design or Challenging Assumptions method to solve the problem of mobile phone addiction among students.
